name: Vice City Oceanarium
summary: An oceanarium under a dome on the north-east of Catalan Key, with a big shark-mouth display.
body: The Big Lead names the Vice City Oceanarium as the dome on the north-east of Catalan Key and says a Vice City Manatees card sits by the turtle decoration inside its big shark-mouth display.

name: Salton Memorial Island
summary: An island above Starfish Island where The Big Lead places the Blanco Memorial sculpture.
body: The Big Lead places Salton Memorial Island above Starfish Island and says the Blanco Memorial WAiNK sculpture is there.

name: Casanova Island
summary: An island of houses in Vice City where The Big Lead found two collectible cards.
body: The Big Lead places a Vice City Manatees card in a garage on the south edge of Casanova Island and a Los Santos Pounders card upstairs in a house at its north.

name: Vespucci Island
summary: An island with a mansion robbery opportunity and several card-holding garages.
body: The Big Lead mentions a Vespucci Mansion robbery opportunity on Vespucci Island and several cards in garages there, including one south of the bridge out of the island.

name: Oldby Island
summary: An island in Vice Beach where Push Square places the Ajax Gym on Vickery Dr.
body: Push Square places the Ajax Gym on Vickery Dr, Oldby Island, Vice Beach, Vice-Dale County.

name: Crosstown Police Station
summary: A gated police station on NW 9th St in Crosstown with a multi-level car park.
body: Push Square places the Crosstown Police Station on NW 9th St, Crosstown, Vice City, behind a gate, and says Randy's Pegassi Infernus waits on the 7th level of its car park, where a stunt jump leads out.

name: Bret's hunting cabin
summary: Bret's cabin north of the Kalaga Reservoir, just west of the Junkyard T-Rex sculpture.
body: Push Square places the Junkyard T-Rex just east of Bret's hunting cabin, off Sassafrass Rd north of the Kalaga Reservoir in Mount Kalaga National Park.
